kit.title: Small-Nonprofit Restricted Grant & Audit Readiness Kit
kit.summary: Reconciles ledger rows against restricted grant line items, lists missing receipt attachments as explicit nulls instead of zeros, and drafts narrative variance notes for treasurer review.

steps.title: Recompute restricted grant spend by budget category
steps.guidance: Sum posted expenses per grant code, flag unreceipted rows as missing, and compute remaining restricted balance.

steps.title: Draft quarterly grant progress and variance summary
steps.guidance: Summarize completed deliverables and flag any line variance above 10% for budget-modification review.

steps.title: Approve restricted-fund allocation and variance treatment
steps.guidance: Review every flagged receipt gap and approve any cost-reallocation request.

steps.title: File signed report in funder or regulator portal
steps.guidance: External portal submissions and 990 schedules are filed only by an authorized officer.

skill.name: restricted-grant-reconciler
skill.description: Reconciles nonprofit ledger rows against restricted grant budgets without inventing missing numbers.
skill.instructions: Check each expense row's grant tag, date window, and receipt attachment status. Report missing receipts as null/unverified rather than zero, highlight budget lines with >10% variance, and output a review packet for the board treasurer.
refuses: Estimating or inventing missing receipt amounts
Submitting grant reports or tax filings externally

tool.name: check_grant_budget_variance
tool.description: Computes line-by-line restricted grant spend, remaining balance, variance percent, and missing-receipt count.

checklist: Verify every expense date falls inside the grant agreement's start and end dates.
Keep unreceipted transactions in a separate 'pending documentation' list instead of counting them as cleared.
Require board treasurer sign-off before requesting a budget-line modification above 10%.

sources.title: IRS Compliance Guide for 501(c)(3) Public Charities (Publication 4221-PC)

fixtures.scenario: Quarterly food-program grant within all line caps and fully receipted
fixtures.sample_input: SYNTHETIC: Grant G-2026-04 food supplies budget USD 12,000; 14 posted invoices totaling USD 11,420 with matching receipts inside Q3.

fixtures.scenario: Cold-storage equipment repair puts supplies line 16% over cap plus one missing invoice
fixtures.sample_input: SYNTHETIC: Grant G-2026-04 equipment line budget USD 2,000; posted charges USD 2,320 and row L-88 lacks vendor receipt PDF.

review_notes: Honest-null handling of missing receipts verified; treasurer approval and external filing remain strictly human_only.
